g.text: Colombia · INS event 210 · Weekly sums of available department records
INS / Sivigila, datos.gov.co/4hyg-wa9d · Snapshot retrieved 2 November 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0
32 departments contribute records; Bogotá is unavailable. Absent department-week rows are not inferred zeros.
Closed years do not establish complete capture. Week 53 occurs only in 2020. Figure: Brandon Huynh.
